fit_set.method: sha256 over sorted(basename + bytes) of the SERVED posterior_summary_*.json files (not_served stems excluded; n_arms counts the same files)

fit_frame.note: served pool fits stand on the wave's own task frame; interim models on the candidate wave's

gates.convention: FAIL iff divergences/(chains×samples) > 0.5% or R-hat gate not pass or ESS gate FAIL
gates.line: sampler gate (0.5%-of-draws convention): 32 of 55 pass · max divergence share 0.01% · R-hat ≤ 1.045 · bulk-ESS ≥ 95

definition_of_record: reliability = the average-rate 1% crossing; fitting's exact levels tables = the median-task crossing
